evidence.claim: Planting one assertionless test, one unconditional skip, and one always-xfail is recovered by the census as three separate buckets plus a union of node ids. skipif(True) and unittest.skip / expectedFailure are additional members of the skip and xfail buckets.

A test with an assertion, skipif(False), a runtime skipif, xfail(False), a conditional xfail, and pytest.raises are absent from the matching no-op buckets. Planted fixtures are excluded from the live union. Splicing an assert into the planted assertionless test makes the detector silent (two-state DIFFERS).
